suite: the DAG zoom, Fit and the grid header
expect_red: [real] Fit shows the whole map at one step

mutations.contract: Fit's scale is the one that fits the whole drawing.
mutations.note: Re-pointed at the map and the grid (the_map_is_the_only_drawing_and_classic_retires, 2026-11-17).
mutations.find: var k = Math.min(width / bounds.w, height / bounds.h, VA.MAP_ZOOM.fitMax);
mutations.replace: var k = Math.min(2 * width / bounds.w, 2 * height / bounds.h, VA.MAP_ZOOM.fitMax);
